images.title: The Charter: a calm lane, and wild water beyond it
images.prompt: Painterly cinematic realism, a hand-finished film matte painting of an age-of-sail world. Dawn over a quiet crescent bay. A broad wooden ferry crosses one glassy, ink-blue lane of perfectly calm water, its small crew standing together on deck, heads lifted as if singing; just beyond the lane the open sea rises and falls on its own in sea-green swells and foam. At the tideline in the middle distance, small and seen from behind, stand a heavy, sun-damaged, barefoot middle-aged sailor with a short grey beard, in a salt-stained linen shirt and rolled dark canvas trousers, and beside him a young woman in her twenties with long dark hair and a pale dress stained with sand and salt, holding a thick sheaf of pages whose last sheet hangs longest. Dawn-gold light from the low left. Palette: dawn gold, ink-blue, sea-green, foam white. The lower quarter of the frame is smooth wet sand, empty and calm. images.title: No Lord: an ordinary man rowing in at dawn
images.prompt: Painterly cinematic realism, a hand-finished film matte painting of an age-of-sail world. Dawn on an ordinary sea, neither glassy nor stormy, small grey-green waves. In a small wooden dinghy, a heavy, sun-damaged, barefoot middle-aged sailor with a short grey beard, in a salt-stained linen shirt and rolled dark canvas trousers rows toward shore, seen from behind and slightly above, shoulders bent, hands wrapped in strips of rag on the worn oars. He does not look round. Far off an old fishing boat rides at anchor with a few small figures at its rail, and on the headland a white lamp tower stands dark and unlit, its buoys drifting out of line. Soft dawn-gold light from the low left, thin mist, nothing uncanny in the light: he is only a man. Palette: dawn gold, tea brown, muted sea-green, foam white. The lower quarter of the frame is plain open water, calm and empty. His face is not shown, no text, no lettering, no watermark, no logo
images.needs_review: He rows standing and the dinghy fills the lower quarter, so there is no empty water for the caption; the far boat is a two-masted ship. The retry (job 59eafbb9-9eef-4721-9dea-ec995a21e06d) showed his face in profile, looking round, so the first image was kept.

images.title: The Wild Sea: the storm he made, and the moorings lifting
images.prompt: Painterly cinematic realism, a hand-finished film matte painting of an age-of-sail world. A storm at sea under storm-violet cloud, a torn seam of dawn gold at the horizon. On the bowsprit of an old single-masted wooden sailing boat stands a heavy, sun-damaged, barefoot middle-aged sailor with a short grey beard, in a salt-stained linen shirt and rolled dark canvas trousers, seen from behind, feet planted, one arm raised and turning, a faint sea-green rim of light on his shoulders. Great sea-green waves and foam climb around the bow. Along the bottom of the frame runs a low, dark strip of harbour coast: stone quays, small moored boats lifting on their lines, lamps guttering, and one small figure, a woman in a pale dress, walking away along the quay with her back to the sea. Driving rain. Palette: storm violet, sea-green, foam white, dawn gold. The lower quarter stays dark and quiet. No trident, no crown, no wreckage, no text, no lettering, no watermark, no logo

images.title: The Lord's Peace: he stirs the water, and it does nothing
images.prompt: Painterly cinematic realism, a hand-finished film matte painting of an age-of-sail world. Flat white noon on a clean sandy beach, almost no shadows. a heavy, sun-damaged, barefoot middle-aged sailor with a short grey beard, in a salt-stained linen shirt and rolled dark canvas trousers stands ankle-deep at the water's edge, seen from behind, head lowered; one hand turns a glass bottle, the other trails in the water at his ankles, stirring. The water does not answer: the sea is one sheet of ink-blue glass to the horizon, without a ripple or a line of foam. Across it, identical buoys with small bells stand at exactly even intervals in ruled rows, and a tidy white trading port sits too clean on the far shore. Flat lamp-white light from directly above. Palette: ink-blue, lamp white, tea brown, a little ledger red on the buoys. The lower quarter is pale, empty sand. His face is not shown, no text, no lettering, no watermark, no logo

images.title: Paid in Kind: all he asked for was a ripple
images.prompt: Painterly cinematic realism, a hand-finished film matte painting of an age-of-sail world. Dawn at the tideline of a quiet bay, beside a standing stone. a heavy, sun-damaged, barefoot middle-aged sailor with a short grey beard, in a salt-stained linen shirt and rolled dark canvas trousers crouches at the water's edge, seen from behind, one finger turning in the shallows; a single small ring of ripples spreads from it and nothing more. Around his feet eight small scraps of old paper float in the foam, their ink dissolving in sea-green threads, the paper going blank. Out in the bay a white lamp tower still burns and a row of evenly spaced buoys still stands; beyond them the open water heaves wild, sea-green under storm-violet cloud, out of his reach. Dawn-gold light from the low left. Palette: dawn gold, sea-green, foam white, ink-blue. The lower quarter is smooth wet sand, calm and empty. His face is not shown; no halo, no glow, no text, no lettering, no watermark, no logo
images.needs_review: He is younger, dark-haired and partly in profile, the paper scraps carry text-like marks and lie on dark sand in the lower quarter. The retry (job 30e6f044-05ca-4ccc-99e1-754122c0de9a) had an awkward squat with the ripple between his legs, so the first image was kept.
